The test image shows a tomato leaf with:
- Numerous small, dark brown/black spots scattered across the leaf
- Yellow/chlorotic halos around many spots
- Necrotic browning at leaf margins
- Spots appear pinpoint to ~3mm in size

This pattern strongly suggests **Bacterial Speck of Tomato** (small dark spots with yellow halos). Now I'll view one reference image to confirm.

The reference image for Bacterial Speck shows small, dark spots on tomato leaves with lighter halos — matching the test image well. The test image has more pronounced yellow chlorosis around spots, but the spot morphology (small, dark, numerous, scattered) is consistent with Bacterial Speck.
